notes.title: Patch #2. Significant improvements in the dialogue.
notes.notes:
Patch #2.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838758/89f82c985c95f207b845120069f5f77a7090a0bb.png[/img]

[b]Second patch released[/b]

Hello all. I got comment that English translation is not very bad, but it could be better. So i cooperated with [b]professional translator[/b] and he corrected all dialogues in English version of game. Almost every sentence has some improvements.

I hope that the new translation will help English speaking players enjoy the game better.

Now I will try to add more languages.

Changelog

1. Significant improvements in the dialogue.
2. In one scene, Yakedo was speaking Dan's dialogue.
3. I added two new song to first ending,
4. I added smooth transition between background music.

I hope you enjoy the game

Best wishes, FOG.

notes.title: Patch #1. Extended Music, Dialogs Fixes.
notes.notes:
Patch #1

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838758/a013bb784619d6c4c3a390e6e96f505d01ea3749.png[/img]

[b]First patch released![/b]

I updated music to extended versions, each song is longer than before. I fixed some dialogs as well. Details are below.

Changelog

1. I changed credits background, i cannot believe i left demo credits image :)
2. I got feedback about English translation, i fixed/changed few sentences.
    - `I forgive you everything, Mirian` => `I forgive you for everything, Mirian`
    - `out od steam` => `out of steam`
    - `does him and shi listen to` => `Do they listen to`
    - `A few-centimeter hole right on the edge` => `A few centimeters long hole right on the edge`.
    - `Yami shakes her head, barely visibly raising his hands in defense` => Yami shakes her head, barely visibly raising her hands in defense`
    - `Yakedo sits with Dan and Shi sits with Yami` => `Yakedo sits with Dan, and Shi sits with Yami.`
    - `WHY IT HAD TO BE YOU?!` => `WHY DID IT HAVE TO BE YOU?!`
    - `I reach higher floor` => `I reach the upper floor`
    - `I come to ask why?` => `I come to ask, why?`
3. I added new version of music, all tracks are longer now (thank you Andrew).
If you like it you can check more beautiful tracks on Andrew's album.
Link here: [url=https://open.spotify.com/album/41QmWQLDXmb8HwFuYlhUQK?si=69XV4EgYQDSHPpgY-M0Q4w]Andrew Tkachuk - Neon Skies, Vol 06[/url]

[b]Also, I am focusing on English translation improvements and thinking about Japanese translation.[/b]

I hope you enjoy the game

Best wishes, FOG.

PS. I work on a new game, more details soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838758/f461d696bc715c7ce8276b7c57fd5e2b36f45c7a.png[/img]

notes.title: Dev Diary #3. Ready for Release.
notes.notes:
Dev Diary #3.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44838758/69887a9b72ce672f9094cdbac6641b85a9acdc11.png[/img]

I almost finished work on Bloody Good Friends. All assets have been implemented and added to game engine. Now I am checking if everything works correctly and i am preparing myself for premiere.

The action of the game takes place over 6 days. It should take about 3 hours to read entire story.

Also game has two different ending, imho both are crazy. 

I hope you will enjoy the game

Best wishes, FOG.

notes.title: Dev Diary #2. Music in Game
notes.notes:
Dev Diary #2.

Today, I would like to focus on music included in Bloody Good Friends. I believe that appropriate music allows you to delve deeper into the story you are reading.

I am grateful that I had the opportunity to use the music of one of the best composers I have ever heard - Andrew Tkachuk.

Thank you very much Andrew.

Several of his songs were used in the game, the first is [url=https://open.spotify.com/track/57Wz0yzywfyrBpCZwz24Vr?si=f65c32ee3b5a4229]Distant Worlds from Neon Skies, Vol. 06[/url] album. I use it in the main menu and in the first day of game's story.

Also, you can follow him on Spotify or YouTube.

Spotify Artist Page: [url=https://open.spotify.com/artist/6ZvrqVAjIkGRZ2vgEYnx5f]Link[/url]
YouTube Channel: [url=https://www.youtube.com/@AndrewTkachukMusic/videos]Link[/url]

Best wishes, FOG.

Also game has 7 different backgrounds which are already done, month ago.
